# Teton Gravity Research

> > Teton Gravity Research (TGR) is the premier action sports media company covering freeride skiing, snowboarding, mountain biking, and adventure culture.

Founded by Todd Jones and based around Jackson Hole Mountain Resort, TGR produces award-winning films, athlete profiles, snow forecasts, and breaking news from the world of big mountain skiing, backcountry exploration, and extreme sports. The site features content from legendary athletes like Kai Jones, Ian McIntosh, and Nick McNutt, covering destinations from Alaska to the Alps.

## Key Topics

- Freeride skiing and snowboarding
- Jackson Hole Mountain Resort
- Backcountry skiing
- Teton Gravity Research films and media
- Alaska and British Columbia skiing
- Alterra Mountain Company resorts
- Big mountain athletes (Kai Jones, Ian McIntosh, Nick McNutt)
- Ski resort developments and infrastructure
- Winter sports competitions (Red Bull Rampage, FIS freeride)
- Powder forecasts and snow conditions
- Mountain biking and lift-accessed bike parks
- Adventure filmmaking and documentaries
- Women's freeride progression
- Street skiing and urban features
